Two Indian Companies Plan Major IPOs Amidst Market Activity

Two prominent Indian companies, social media platform ShareChat and brewing giant Carlsberg, are reportedly planning Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) to raise significant capital. ShareChat aims to raise $400 million, while Carlsberg is looking to raise $700 million. These plans indicate substantial activity in India's capital markets.
